title: How the Cops Are in GTA 5... 8
author: ReidBoehm

audit.editing_archetype: Live-action green screen sketch comedy with in-world phone integration
audit.framing_9x16: Clean vertical 9:16 green screen composition with high-fidelity background replacement matching GTA 5 Los Santos street environments.
audit.subtitle_craft: Minimalist on-screen text for the title hook at the beginning; clean performance-driven dialogue with exact sync to actor mouths and actions.
audit.zoom_and_camera_work: Creative in-world phone perspective shifts where the camera physically zooms into and out of a smartphone screen displaying the previous footage loop.
audit.sfx_and_music_craft: Sharp sound effect triggers on punches, slaps, taser draws, and dramatic whines, paired with precise comedic timing on audio cuts.
audit.comedic_timing_and_cuts: Tight escalation structure featuring character confusion, absurd cop logic, video-evidence playback, and a chaotic dance finale payoff.
standout_techniques: Green screen character cloning for multi-role interactions
In-scene smartphone display playback looping prior joke frames
GTA wanted star UI overlay appearing on cue over the actor's head
Precise match-cuts between live-action acting and recorded phone playback
anti_patterns_to_avoid: Over-cluttering the screen with unnecessary floating emojis during dialogue
